item.title: Klipper vs Marlin vs RepRapFirmware in 2026: Which 3D Printer Firmware Should You Actually Flash?
item.description: Your printer’s mainboard is not the bottleneck. Its firmware is. A stock Ender 3 with Marlin and a stock Ender 3 running Klipper on a $15 Raspberry Pi are the same hardware with wildly different acceleration ceilings — and the difference shows up as ringing, corner bulge, and print time, not as a spec-sheet number.
